description: Tencent announced the Hy4 preview, an open-weight text‑only large language model. It has 770 billion total parameters, 49 billion active parameters, a 1 million token context window, and the model files total about 1.56 TB on Hugging Face. This follows the earlier Hy3 model (295 B total, 21 B active, 256 k token context).

canonical_title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
description: Nvidia announced a new generation of data center systems that improve AI performance by employing smarter traffic control mechanisms instead of relying solely on additional GPU processing cycles.

canonical_title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
description: Vijay Pande departed a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year and founded VZVC, a much smaller AI‑native venture. In discussing the move, he described biology moving from a pure discovery discipline toward an engineering approach, noted that clinical trials remain extremely costly, and argued that open, shared datasets—not proprietary ones—are essential for AI to transform medicine.

canonical_title: Musicians-turned-detectives are hunting for AI grifters
description: As generative audio tools improve, AI‑generated songs that copy human artists are proliferating online. Some creators openly acknowledge using AI, while others deny it. In response, a group of musicians has begun investigating and identifying those who falsely claim their work is original, labeling them as AI grifters.

canonical_title: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
description: The California legislature voted unanimously to exempt Linux and other software distributed under GPL, MIT, BSD and Apache licenses from the state's recently enacted age‑verification requirements.
